An improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command vulnerability in the VPN API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote authenticated users with administrator privileges to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

Dell PowerStore contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An authenticated user with limited privileges could potentially exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to root on the appliance.

Philips Hue Bridge Pro SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge Pro. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the HTTP service, which listens on TCP port 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-33089.

When using GCC, building a malicious package that uses cgo could cause arbitrary command execution at link time via untrusted GCC spec files ("specs" or "*.spec"). When linking with "-fopenmp", "-fopenacc", or "-fsanitize=" in "#cgo LDFLAGS", GCC's built-in link spec evaluates "%:include(libgomp.spec)" or "%:include(libsanitizer.spec)" and searches for spec files in "-L" and sysroot directories (including subdirectories and multilib sibling directories such as "../lib64"), as well as the working directory when "-fopenmp" or "-fopenacc" is used or when "-fsanitize=" is combined with "-static" or "-static-lib*". The go command now rejects "-L", "-isysroot", and "-Wl,-syslibroot" directories (and the working and package directories when applicable) that contain GCC spec files, and disallows "@" and "-" prefixes in "-fsanitize=" compiler flag values.

NocoDB before 2026.06.2 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in base-user.cte.utils.ts, which concatenates base members' email addresses into the SQL text of queries resolving user, created-by or last-modified-by fields. Registered users can set an email with a quoted local part containing a single quote to execute arbitrary SQL, exposing user records, API tokens and data-source credentials.

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in SLEOB::slInvoiceNumber() in src/Billing/SLEOB.php, which concatenates the CLP01 claim identifier from uploaded X12 835 ERA files into a query without escaping or parameter binding. Authenticated users with billing permissions, or a malicious payer whose ERA file a clerk uploads, can execute arbitrary SQL to read any table, including users_secure password hashes, and modify data.

OS command injection (CWE-78) in the network-configuration handling of the management service (uavmonitor_usbv1) of the 1300 communications board in DJI AeroScope Mobile (TP703) firmware 03.00.00.26, with 1300 communications board firmware 02.00.07.12 through 02.00.08.40, allows an unauthenticated attacker on the local network to execute arbitrary commands as root. Configuration values that can be written without authentication over the management interface are inserted unquoted into shell commands. Exploitation requires network access to TCP port 16000 on the board and that the unit is not connected to another controlling host. The injected command persists across reboots. Confirmed on a physical device.



NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. DJI has discontinued AeroScope Mobile and no fixed firmware is available.

VoAPI 1.0.0 through 1.2.0 contains a sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users to inject SQL by supplying crafted column names as search[...] filter keys on list endpoints such as GET /api/log. Attackers can read the HS256 JWT signing secret from the option table and forge a manager role token to take over the /api/m/* management API.

django-tenants 3.4.8 before 4.0.1 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in its PostgreSQL backend that allows attackers to inject SQL through unescaped tenant schema names. Attackers who can choose or influence a schema name can supply quote characters that are interpolated into SET search_path and CREATE, DROP or ALTER SCHEMA statements, letting them read other tenants' data or run SQL as the application's database user.

In Progress® Telerik® Reporting prior to version 20.3.26.1110, a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability in the .NET Framework report designers allows a local attacker with low privileges to execute arbitrary code in the context of the designer process when the user performs certain editing operations.

A weakness has been identified in Linux Foundation Magma up to 1.9.0. The impacted element is an unknown function of the file orc8r/cloud/go/services/obsidian/access/operator.go of the component Obsidian REST. Executing a manipulation of the argument X-Magma-Client-Cert-Serial can lead to authentication bypass by spoofing. The attack can be launched remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.2 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.7 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.10 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.2 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.7 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2.10 through 7.2.12, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12 may allow an authenticated administrator to write arbitrary files via a specially crafted archive.

NocoBase plugin-ai 2.1.0 through 2.2.41 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in getAccessibleAIEmployee() that lets authenticated users access unassigned AI employees by overriding the role-derived filter with a supplied username. Attackers can use the dispatch-sub-agent-task tool to run ungranted AI employees with their tools and permissions, and get-ai-employee to read their prompts and tool configuration.

Poste Italiane Postecert FIRMAOK! 1.6.29 on Windows contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability caused by an uncontrolled OpenSSL search path, where launcher.exe and dependent executables such as updater.exe and tslupdater.exe load OpenSSL configuration and library files from a hardcoded, user-writable directory that does not exist by default. A low-privileged local attacker can create this missing directory and place malicious OpenSSL configuration or library files inside it, causing the application to load and execute attacker-controlled code with the privileges of the user running it, enabling horizontal or, when a higher-privileged user runs the application, vertical privilege escalation up to full system compromise.

Zr.Admin.NET commit 0ee1ab8 through commit eb9228a contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows any logged-in user to read arbitrary server files via the path parameter of /common/DownloadFile. Attackers can supply absolute paths or ../ sequences to read appsettings files and use the JwtSettings SecretKey to forge administrator tokens.

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability in CcrTable::insertApprovedData() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through request parameter names used as column names. Attackers can send crafted patient_data-*-sel parameters to the revandapprove route, lacking ACL and CSRF checks, to copy password hashes into patient fields or corrupt records.

The labeled-response module in UnrealIRCd 6.0.0 before 6.2.7.1 does not escape the IRCv3 "label" message tag when echoing it into replies, which allows any user on a network with two or more linked servers to inject server-to-server commands that are executed with server authority.

A vulnerability was determined in D-Link DIR-878 1.20B05. This impacts the function SetVLANSettings of the file prog.cgi of the component HNAP Handler. Executing a manipulation of the argument VID can lead to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

Command injection in the documentserver-flush-cache.sh maintenance helper in ONLYOFFICE Docs (Document Server) 9.4.0-129 on the official onlyoffice/documentserver container allows a local attacker with command execution as the ds user to execute arbitrary commands as root via a crafted --hash argument that is interpolated unvalidated into a GNU sed expression, where the sed e flag runs attacker-controlled commands. The packaged sudoers policy permits ds to run the helper as root without a password and with unrestricted arguments.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an sql injection vulnerability that allows authenticated users with read access to run arbitrary read queries via the legacy where parameter on PostgreSQL. Attackers, including Viewer-role users, can inject single quotes into filter values concatenated by CustomKnex.ts to read other tables, schemas, view-filtered rows, and hidden columns.

DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.1 through 3.8.0 contains an HTML injection vulnerability in ReportGenerator.generate_task_report that allows registered users to read server files and perform SSRF. Attackers can create a project whose name contains a link attachment element and download the task PDF report to retrieve local files or internal network responses.

DeepAudit 2.0.0-beta.5 through 3.8.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows registered users to leak server-wide GitLab or Gitea tokens via repository_url. Attackers can create a gitlab or gitea project pointing to a controlled host and request its branches to capture the operator's token and reach internal hosts.

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in the Syndromic Surveillance report because the form_icd_codes[] POST array is concatenated into an unquoted numeric IN() clause without integer validation. Authenticated users can submit quote-free payloads that bypass add_escape_custom to perform blind or UNION-based injection and exfiltrate patient health information.

Zipline through 4.3.2 contains a path traversal vulnerability that allows authenticated uploaders to write files outside the upload directory by supplying traversal sequences in the x-zipline-filename header. Attackers using the local datasource can create or overwrite files writable by the Zipline process, corrupting application data or disrupting service.

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in era_payments.php and sl_eob_search.php that allows authenticated billing users to write files outside the ERA directory. Attackers can embed traversal sequences in the GS04 element of an uploaded X12 835 file to overwrite .edi or .835 files with attacker-controlled content anywhere writable by the web server.

Rocboss paopao-ce 0.2.0 through 0.6.0-alpha.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in LocalOSS DeleteObject that allows authenticated users to delete arbitrary files by submitting crafted media values. Attackers can send dot-dot-slash sequences in the avatar or media content to POST /v1/user/avatar or POST /v1/post/comment, deleting server-writable files including configuration and data.

REBUILD 2.7.0 through 4.5.4 contains an SQL injection vulnerability that allows low-privileged authenticated users to inject AjQL conditions through the plan parameter of /project/tasks/list. Attackers can use priority-* plans and the returned task count as a boolean oracle to recover a task creator's SHA-256 password hash and log in as that user, including the administrator.

Zohocorp ManageEngine M365 Manager Plus versions below 4818 is affected by an authenticated technician may exploit insufficient permission validation in the delegated administration interface to escalate privileges beyond their intended scope, which could result in remote code execution during administrative processing.

Missing authorization in the external management API in Amazon mcp-gateway-registry 1.0.9 through 1.24.7 might allow an authenticated remote user to assign the registry administrator scope to their own identity group and obtain administrative control of every registered gateway asset via a crafted group import request.



To remediate this issue, users should upgrade to version 1.25.0.

Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root via the WireGuard server private_key option. Attackers can save a private key containing $() command substitution, which runs when action_wireguards_export() passes it to luci.sys.exec during configuration export.

Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains a command injection vulnerability that allows authenticated administrators to execute commands as root by injecting newlines into reboot_time. Attackers can submit a reboot_time value followed by a newline and crontab line, which /etc/init.d/autoreboot writes to the root crontab for crond to run.

Prime CMS (@primecms/core) through 0.4.0-beta.0 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the updateSystem GraphQL mutation that allows authenticated administrators to execute shell commands via the package version string. Attackers can append shell metacharacters to the unvalidated version value, which is passed to child_process.exec() in yarn add or npm install commands, executing commands as the server process.

A incorrect authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12 may allow an authenticated administrator to escalate their privileges, bypass authorization controls or impersonate internal services via specially crafted requests to the GUI.

Zipline versions from 3.4.5 before 3.7.10 contain a path traversal vulnerability in the user data export endpoint via the name query parameter. Authenticated attackers can bypass the user id check and use directory traversal sequences to read arbitrary files on the server host.

A vulnerability in the Open Client Interface (OCI) XML Parser of Cisco BroadWorks could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to read sensitive configuration information on an affected system. 
 This vulnerability exists because XML entries are improperly parsed due to external entity resolution being allowed by default. An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a crafted XML message to the Open Client Interface – Provisioning (OCI-P) service. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to view sensitive files from the filesystem with the privileges of the Cisco BroadWorks user.

A improper neutralization of special elements used in a template engine vulnerability in Fortinet FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2 all versions, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2 all versions may allow a low privileged Device Manager admin to obtain super admin privilege on managed FortiGates via injecting malicious commands.

NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Editor users to execute scripts by storing crafted attachment MIME types like text/html;image/png. Attackers can write the value through the records API so the /dltemp signed URL serves HTML inline, stealing session tokens from localStorage to impersonate victims.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated Creator users to inject script by embedding markup in column or table titles. The Delete.vue confirmation dialog renders these titles through an unescaped innerHTML binding, executing script when a victim deletes an external-source table to steal session tokens from localStorage.
In Open Object Rexx (ooRexx) before 5.2.0, RXAPI mishandles nameArg and userid bounds checking, possibly leading to arbitrary code execution via crafted messages.

A improper neutralization of special elements used in an ldap query ('ldap injection') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAuthenticator 8.0.0 through 8.0.3, FortiAuthenticator 6.6.0 through 6.6.10 may allow an authenticated attacker to bypass authentication. Successful exploitation requires either a malicious/compromised upstream IdP, or an IdP configuration that allows the user to control the NameID (or the SAML attribute used as the username).

Hugo Blog is a tech blog site. In commit 744ca15 and prior, the AI assistant proxy exposes three HTTP endpoints (POST /api/blog-assistant, POST /api/blog-search-embedding, POST /api/blog-search-rerank) without any authentication check. When deployed following the documented Nginx reverse-proxy setup, any unauthenticated remote attacker can send arbitrary requests that the proxy forwards to the upstream LLM/embedding/rerank API using the operator's server-side API key (OPENAI_API_KEY / AI_SEARCH_API_KEY). This enables unlimited quota consumption, cost exhaustion, and potential service unavailability for the operator. At time of publication, there are no publicly available patches.

This vulnerability affects customers using Arista Pathfinder for WAN path selection with Border Gateway Protocol-Link State (BGP-LS) configured for Dynamic Path Selection (DPS). On affected platforms running Arista EOS with BGP-LS configured for DPS, an attacker who has established an authenticated BGP-LS session with the device can send a specially crafted BGP packet to cause incorrect WAN path selection and disrupt traffic forwarding.

Zohocorp ManageEngine AssetExplorer versions below 7860, ServiceDesk Plus versions below 15290, ServiceDesk Plus MSP versions below 15150, and SupportCenter Plus versions below 15150 are affected by a authenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the Reports module. An authenticated user with the Create Query Reports permission could exploit specially crafted database queries to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying server.

IBM ContextForge MCP Gateway 1.0.0 through 1.1.0 is vulnerable to improper credential handling because the X-Upstream-Authorization request header can override the gateway-managed upstream credential for OAuth (authorization_code and client_credentials), bearer and basic authenticated gateways, which could allow an authenticated user to cause upstream requests to be made with a different credential and bypass per-user permission and audit attribution.

CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, the ExecShellTool::approval_requirement_for path used is_parallel_readonly_command to downgrade commands to automatic approval based on a flag-stripped command allowlist. The allowlist treated fd, rg, and git grep as read-only even when fd -x or fd --exec, rg --pre, or git grep --open-files-in-pager selected an external program. registered_tool_approval_required returned without displaying a prompt for that automatic classification, and the later command-safety check also treated the base utilities as safe. Attacker-controlled content that influenced an agent tool call could therefore cause arbitrary program execution on the developer host without the approval promised by the default interactive profile, resulting in unauthorized access, modification, or disruption. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

A use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability in Fortinet FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11 may allow an adjacent-network authenticated attacker with user permission to join the FGFM configuration-sync mesh of the affected FortiGate deployment via the default pre-shared key.

AsyncSSH is a Python package which provides an asynchronous client and server implementation of the SSHv2 protocol on top of the Python asyncio framework. Prior to 2.24.1, SFTPServer.map_path() uses posixpath.normpath() on a client-supplied path and removes only one leading slash before passing the result to posixpath.join() with the configured chroot. An authenticated SFTP user can supply a path beginning with exactly two slash characters, causing POSIX normalization to preserve the double-leading-slash form and the subsequent join to treat the remaining pathname as absolute. This bypasses the SFTP chroot and permits reads and writes with the operating-system permissions of the account running the server, which may enable code execution depending on writable targets. This issue is fixed in version 2.24.1.

Untrusted search path in the cross-user process launcher in Open Job Description (OpenJD) Sessions for Python before 0.11.0, as used in the AWS Deadline Cloud worker agent before 0.33.0, on Linux might allow an authenticated remote user with permission to submit jobs to a queue to execute arbitrary code as the worker agent OS user and obtain the AWS credentials held by the worker agent via a crafted job that modifies the PATH environment variable.



To remediate this issue, users of customer-managed fleets should upgrade the Deadline Cloud worker agent to version 0.33.0 or later, which includes OpenJD Sessions 0.11.0. Service-managed fleets were remediated service-side.

Use after free in PostgreSQL pltcl allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a domain CHECK that re-enters the Tcl interpreter and frees or changes a string still used by the outer result conversion.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

Uncaught exceptions in PostgreSQL plperl allow an object creator to cause use of a stale sigjmp_buf, via a tied Perl object, or a Perl object whose overloaded conversion throws while plperl is handling another error.  We have not ruled out arbitrary code execution on some platform.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

Integer wraparound in PostgreSQL generation memory contexts allows a database user to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via freeing an allocation larger than 1 GB and causing its block to be reused for smaller chunks whose back-pointer offset cannot represent that position.  Within major versions 16-18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, and 16.16 are affected.  Versions before PostgreSQL 16 are unaffected.

Type confusion in PostgreSQL statistics import allows a table maintainer to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via nested SET DATA TYPE during conversion of values to import.  Within major version 18, minor versions before PostgreSQL 18.7 are affected.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18 are unaffected.

Use after free in the PostgreSQL dblink extension allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via type conversion code that re-enters dblink and closes a connection whose results an outer dblink call is reading.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

Heap-based buffer overflow in PostgreSQL foreign batch inserts allows a foreign server to execute arbitrary code, via reporting that it inserted more rows than the server supplied.  postgres_fdw can legitimately encounter this when a rule on the remote table expands an INSERT into additional rows.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

Use after free in PostgreSQL expanded-record domain checks allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via repeated checks of a domain over a composite type that cause reuse of a dangling memory-context pointer.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

XWEB EVO before 5.6.2 contains a hardcoded backdoor password vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain full administrative access to the built-in Administrator account. Attackers can authenticate using the hardcoded credential xwebevonewgeneration in a single request to obtain a complete admin session and full control over the application. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in Nasir Ahmed Advanced Form Integration advanced-form-integration allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects Advanced Form Integration: from n/a through 2.11.3.

TridotsTech go1cms master branch through commit 7f68d05 and version-3 branch before commit ead8da3 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the guest-whitelisted update_doc method that allows unauthenticated attackers to modify any document. Attackers can supply a doctype, name and arbitrary fields that are saved with ignore_permissions=True, altering User records to escalate privileges, take over accounts or tamper with business data.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a reflected cross-site scripting vulnerability in PageLeavingWarning.vue that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute script by embedding an ASCII control character in the ncRedirectUrl scheme. Attackers can send a crafted link that bypasses the scheme check and reaches the anchor href or window.location, stealing the session token from localStorage for account takeover.
Privilege escalation in the DOM: Networking component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 159, Firefox ESR 115.44, Firefox ESR 153.6, Thunderbird 159, and Thunderbird 153.6.

A improper certificate validation vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11 may allow a MITM attacker to impersonate the radius server via a rogue RADIUS server.

CodeWhale is a DeepSeek and MiMo coding agent for the terminal. Prior to 0.9.0, DEFAULT_AUTOMATION_AUTO_APPROVE caused AutomationRecord::task_auto_approve to resolve an omitted setting to true, and the automation_create schema advertised the same insecure default. enqueue_run_task converted that omission into an explicit true value, bypassing the safer task-path fallback and selecting ApprovalMode::Bypass for each scheduled run. After a user approved creation of an apparently benign recurring automation, subsequent executions could silently authorize mutating tools without a human present, and an automation created with shell access could repeatedly execute commands. This issue is fixed in version 0.9.0.

A use of externally-controlled format string vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12 may allow an authenticated attacker to execute unauthorized commands via specially crafted HTTP request

A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12 may allow an authenticated attacker with admin privileges to execute unauthorized code or commands via a crafted request.

A unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAnalyzer 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiAnalyzer Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12, FortiManager 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager 7.4.0 through 7.4.11, FortiManager 7.2.0 through 7.2.12, FortiManager Cloud 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiManager Cloud 7.6.0 through 7.6.7, FortiManager Cloud 7.4.1 through 7.4.11, FortiManager Cloud 7.2.1 through 7.2.12 may allow an authenticated administrator to upload arbitrary files via specially crafted requests.

A incorrect authorization vulnerability in Fortinet FortiAuthenticator 8.0.0 through 8.0.3, FortiAuthenticator 6.6.0 through 6.6.10 may allow an attacker to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access. Full impersonation however requires the attacker to obtain pre-required id and data via other means.

Type confusion in PostgreSQL extended statistics allows an object creator to execute arbitrary code as the operating system user running the database, via a statistics expression of an anonymous RECORD type whose backend-local type identifier denotes a different row type in another session.  Versions before PostgreSQL 18.7, 17.12, 16.16, 15.20, and 14.25 are affected.

A code injection vulnerability in promzard’s template-loading functionality allows an attacker who can control property names in the context object (ctx) to execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the Node.js process. The library inserts context property names into a generated function’s parameter list without validation or escaping and evaluates the resulting source using `vm.runInThisContext()`. A crafted property name can escape the parameter list and inject JavaScript code, even when the template file is fully trusted.

OpenMage magento-lts before 20.2.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because the TinyMCE WYSIWYG editor fails to filter scripts in specially crafted HTML tags. Attackers can inject an img element with a malicious onmouseover attribute to execute scripts in the browsers of users viewing the rendered content.

The optional SSH administration service grants full access to the administration shell to every user that authenticates against its configured login domain, without checking for an administrative role. An attacker holding the credentials of any user in that domain, including a low-privileged application user, can execute arbitrary code as the server process. Users are recommended to disable the SSH administration service, or to block network access to it from untrusted clients and restrict its login domain to administrative users.

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows portal patients to run JavaScript in staff sessions by injecting javascript: URLs into document template_data. Attackers can submit an encounterForm value rendered unsanitized into an iframe src by DocumentTemplateRender, letting the script read PHI and CSRF tokens and call staff or admin endpoints.

When a non-default stateful session bean passivation strategy is configured, passivated bean state is written to predictably named files in the shared system temporary directory, reusing files that already exist there, and is deserialized on activation. A local attacker who can write to that directory can read passivated session state or supply data that the server deserializes, potentially leading to code execution as the server process. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The Reset Database plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to privilege escalation in versions up to, and including, 1.1.3. This is due to the process_reset() function being registered on admin_init with no capability check, a computed-but-unused nonce, a gating condition that passes whenever no WordPress administrator literally named 'admin' exists (the default on modern installs), and an identity test that verifies the ATTACKER'S OWN password rather than an administrator's. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to drop every prefixed database table, re-run wp_install() with their own credentials — making the attacker the sole site administrator — authenticate as that administrator via wp_set_auth_cookie(), and delete the uploads directory.

libilbm ILBM File Parsing Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of libilbm. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of ILBM files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-27792.

An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability in the SSOAuth in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.3.2-86009-5 and 7.4.1-90080-1 allows remote authenticated users to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that lets base-scoped API tokens act as account-wide credentials because the token's base_id is never stored or checked. Attackers holding a leaked token can read, write and delete records on every base the token owner belongs to, including bases joined later.

Incorrect default permissions in the agent configuration folder in Devolutions PowerShell Universal 2026.3.4 and earlier allows a local unprivileged user to execute arbitrary code as SYSTEM via a crafted agent configuration file that points the agent to an attacker-controlled server.

The MemberDash plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in all versions up to, and including, 1.8.7. This is due to a mass-assignment vulnerability in the `user_account_manager()` function's edit_profile branch, where all submitted `$_POST` fields are iterated and directly assigned to the current member object via the `MS_Model` `__set()` magic method with no field allowlist and no capability or ownership check on the submitted `id` parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject an arbitrary user ID via the `id` parameter — overwriting any WordPress user's email address and password, including the site administrator's — and subsequently use those modified credentials to gain full administrative access to the site.

Zr.Admin.NET commit af07ffc through commit eb9228a contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in SysProfileController.UpdateProfile that allows any authenticated user to modify other accounts via UserId. Attackers can set the administrator's phone number to one they control, request an SMS code via /checkMobile, and log in through /PhoneLogin to take over the administrator account.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Barn2 Plugins Document Library Pro document-library-pro allows Object Injection.This issue affects Document Library Pro: from n/a before 4.2.2.

A vulnerability has been identified in Rexroth IndraWorks. This flaw allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the user’s system by parsing a manipulated file, because the file parser fails to properly sanitize the path name(s) or references embedded in the manipulated file. Exploitation requires user interaction, specifically opening a specially crafted file, which then causes the application to traverse outside the target directory and to write files in unauthorized locations, eventually enabling Remote Code Execution (RCE). This can lead to a complete compromise of the system running Rexroth IndraWorks.

RedAmon 4.0.0 before 7.8.0 contains a missing object-level authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated users to control other tenants' agent sessions by supplying arbitrary session ids. Attackers can call /api/agent/sessions, interact and kill routes to list, kill, or send commands into other users' meterpreter and shell sessions on their compromised targets.

RedAmon before 7.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in the kali-sandbox terminal server that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain a root shell by connecting to its WebSocket listener on port 8016. Attackers who can reach the port from co-resident containers or the host loopback can send keystrokes to an interactive /bin/bash session, executing commands as root inside the kali-sandbox container.

Contentlayer @contentlayer/source-files through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers who control content files to execute JavaScript by abusing gray-matter's still-enabled JavaScript engine in parseMarkdown(). Attackers can start a Markdown or MDX file with a ---js or ---javascript frontmatter delimiter to run code during build, exposing CI build secrets.
Invalid Memory Access via the MSI-X table in QVM could allow an attacker in the guest to execute arbitrary code in the QVM to cause memory corruption, information disclosure or a crash of the QVM.

Zipline through 3.7.9 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in the /api/auth/register endpoint, which enforces invite codes only when user registration is disabled, so registration succeeds without an invite when both invites and user registration are enabled. Unauthenticated attackers can send a direct POST request omitting the invite code to create accounts, view stats, and exhaust storage by uploading many files.

IBM MQ 9.2.0.0 through 9.2.0.44 LTS, 9.3.0.0 through 9.3.0.42 LTS, 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.0.26 LTS, 9.4.0.0 through 9.4.5.1 CD, and 10.0.0.0 through 10.0.0.5 LTS and CD could allow an authenticated user with command queue access to execute arbitrary code by injecting malicious arguments into Ant script commands.

A type allow-list bypass in the BSON serialization library of the MongoDB C# Driver allows a type-restriction check to be circumvented when polymorphic data is deserialized into loosely typed members. An unauthorized party who can supply or plant BSON/JSON data that the application later deserializes can cause the application process to instantiate .NET types outside the intended allow-list and populate them with unauthorized party-controlled values. In applications that contain a suitable gadget type, this can lead to arbitrary code execution in the context of the application, with corresponding loss of confidentiality, integrity, and availability. No special privileges beyond the ability to introduce data the application reads are required.

The manipulation of the argument swmconfigupload leads to command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used. Upgrading to version 1.5.1.7 addresses this issue. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

MailEnable Save Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create arbitrary files on affected installations of MailEnable. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the Save method. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-29161.

Dell PowerStore contains an External Control of File Name or Path vulnerability. A remote authenticated attacker could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation on the appliance.

CBoard before commit 7bd8180 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows any authenticated user to reach admin functions because AdminController and DashboardController methods bypass AOP role checks. Attackers with no role grants can call deleteUser, deleteRole, getUserList, getAllWidgetList and getAllDatasetList to read query configurations and delete accounts including the administrator.

A high privileged remote attacker can perform a code injection in the backends backup restore function leading to code execution. This can result in a total loss of confidentiality, integrity and availability.

@tinacms/mdx before 2.4.2 contains a code injection vulnerability in its MDX serializer, which writes rich-text values into MDX expressions without escaping them. Authenticated content editors can save crafted values that break out of list field or highlightColor expressions in the stored .mdx file, executing JavaScript in visitors' browsers or on build and server-side rendering hosts.

rsync before 3.5.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the delta-transfer sender's hash_search() in match.c that allows malicious receivers to trigger unbounded strong-checksum work at consecutive offsets. Unauthenticated attackers pulling from a public daemon module can supply weak checksums colliding with consecutive rolling windows plus non-matching strong checksums, exhausting sender CPU across concurrent connections.

Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in gg_get_version() in src/dissectors/ec_gg.c that writes up to 44 bytes into a 30-byte allocation. Remote attackers can send Gadu-Gadu traffic on TCP port 8074 with a crafted version field through a monitored network to corrupt heap memory in the Ettercap process, which normally runs as root.

Ettercap through 0.8.4.1 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Parse_NTLM_Auth() in src/dissectors/ec_http.c due to unvalidated NTLM message offsets. Attackers can send a crafted HTTP Authorization header observed by Ettercap to read beyond the buffer, disclosing memory or crashing the process.

A client certificate authentication bypass in Node.js TLS lets a client change the servername during TLS 1.2 renegotiation to reach endpoints it was not authorized for. On a server that applies different client-certificate policies per hostname, for example stricter admin-only client-cert auth on one host and ordinary client-cert auth on another, a client that authenticates for a permitted host can renegotiate the TLS 1.2 connection under a different servername and carry its existing authentication to the protected host, bypassing the stricter policy. This vulnerability affects Node.js 26.x, 24.x, and 22.x.

XWEB EVO 5.6.2 through 5.8.8 contains a hardcoded credential vulnerability where the Administrator web account is configured to use password_mode daily_password with no stored password, as the Users.authenticate function in lualib_users.lua synthesizes the Administrator configuration without validating any stored secret. Attackers who can derive the MAC-based daily password can authenticate as Administrator to obtain a full admin session on the device. This product line reached it's end of service date in March 2026.

Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an unauthenticated stack buffer overflow vulnerability in the stun_client TR-111 UDP Connection Request parser that parses requests before verifying username or HMAC. Remote attackers can send a single crafted UDP datagram lacking a space in the request line, causing strncpy() to overflow a 10-byte stack buffer and crash stun_client for denial of service.

C-Kermit before 11.1.515 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in putsrv() in ckcfns.c that allows malicious peers to write past the srvcmd buffer by sending crafted packets. Attackers can use Kermit repeat-count compression in server command, GET, or file-header packets to write attacker-chosen bytes beyond the heap buffer on servers or receiving instances.

MRBS before 1.13.0 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to redirect reset links by forging the Host header when $url_base is unset. Attackers can request a reset for a victim so AuthDb::notifyUser() emails a link pointing to their host, capturing the reset key when opened to take over accounts including administrators.

PrestaShop before 8.2.9 and 9.2.1 contains a broken access control vulnerability that allows an authenticated Webservice API key holder to read and modify customer records belonging to any shop in a multi-shop installation. Attackers can exploit the missing record-level shop ownership check in shopHasRight() and saveEntityFromXml() to read sensitive customer data such as password hashes and secure keys, and change a customer's email and password via create, update, and delete requests, resulting in account takeover.

PrestaShop before 8.2.9 and 9.2.1 contains an authorization flaw in the Webservice API that allows an attacker holding a key restricted to one shop to act on data of every shop by submitting requests with id_shop=all or id_shop_group=N, which expand the shop context without validating the key's actual shop associations and cause shopHasRight() to evaluate the expanded set as a disjunction. Attackers can exploit this flaw via classes/webservice/WebserviceRequest.php to read, modify, or delete data belonging to shops they are not authorized for, including full customer records such as email addresses, secure_key, and password hashes across the installation.

termux-sync is an open source tool for backing up and restoring a Termux environment across devices. Prior to 1.2.4, termux-sync restore uses the parent directory of the untrusted manifest.json files.*.source value as an extraction destination, and extract_archive calls tarfile.extract on archive members without enforcing a destination boundary. A victim who restores a malicious or tampered backup from local, shared, GitHub, or Google Drive storage can have files written anywhere the Termux user can write, including shell startup files or executable scripts that can lead to code execution when later used. The restore path also accepts unsafe backup_name values for temporary paths, and archive members are not constrained to the intended destination. This issue is fixed in version 1.2.4.

Axigen Mail Server 10.3.3.67 through 10.3.3.x, 10.4.42 through 10.4.x, 10.5.29 through 10.5.x, 10.6.x before 10.6.41, and 10.7.x before 10.7.3 contains an unauthenticated denial of service vulnerability caused by uncontrolled recursion when validating query parameter and cookie values with a recursive regular expression engine before authentication in the WebAdmin and WebMail services. Attackers can send a single HTTP request with a query parameter or cookie value of a few thousand characters to exhaust the worker thread stack and crash the server process, taking down SMTP, IMAP, POP3, and web services repeatedly.

free5GC WebConsole through 1.4.6 contains an authorization flaw in the ChangePasswordInfo handler that allows authenticated tenant users to change other members' passwords. Attackers can send POST /api/change-password with another tenant member's email and a new password, without the current password, to take over that account.

Dell Display and Peripheral Manager (DDPM Windows), versions prior to 2.4.0.17, contain a Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Condition vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Code execution.

NocoDB from 2026.04.0 before 2026.08.0 contains an improper privilege management vulnerability in org-users.service.ts where updating a user's legacy organization role rewrites their default-workspace role. Revoked users can silently regain Creator-level read, write and schema modification access across all default-workspace bases using their existing session token.

Contentlayer @contentlayer/core through 0.3.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows attackers to inject JavaScript by embedding single quotes in content file names. Attackers can add a content file whose name breaks out of the import specifier in makeDataExportFile(), executing injected code when contentlayer dev or a Next.js dev server imports the generated module.

FFmpeg before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the DVD subtitle encoder that underestimates RLE output size for odd-width rectangles. Attackers can supply files with crafted bitmap subtitles that, when transcoded to the dvdsub encoder, write past the output buffer and corrupt heap memory.

FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in the encode_frame() function of libavcodec/huffyuvenc.c, because encode_init() never validates minimum frame dimensions for the median predictor. Attackers can supply a tiny video, such as a 2-pixel-wide or 1-2-pixel-tall frame, that causes negative sub_median_pred lengths and out-of-bounds reads and writes when transcoded to huffyuv or ffvhuff, crashing the encoder.

FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in dvbsub_encode() in libavcodec/dvbsubenc.c that undercounts each CLUT segment header by two bytes. Attackers can supply a file with many bitmap subtitle rectangles that, when transcoded to the dvbsub encoder, writes past the output buffer and corrupts heap memory.

xschem 2.9.9 through 3.4.7 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in read_dataset() in src/rawtovcd.c due to an unchecked variable index. Attackers can supply a crafted ngspice .raw file that, when converted with rawtovcd, writes file-controlled heap pointers at chosen signed offsets, corrupting heap memory.

Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Mamunur Rashid Testimonial Slider testimonial-slider-and-showcase allows Object Injection.This issue affects Testimonial Slider: from n/a through 3.0.2.

Microsoft jxrlib through 1.1 and the mircomir jxrlib fork before 1.3.1 contain a heap buffer overflow in ReadBinaryData() in jxrgluelib/JXRMeta.c caused by integer overflow of the metadata count. Attackers can supply a JPEG XR file with a count of 0xFFFFFFFE or 0xFFFFFFFF, wrapping PKAlloc(uCount + 2) to an undersized buffer that the following file read overflows, corrupting heap memory in decoding applications.
Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network.

7-Zip File Manager before 26.03 fails to detect archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters, allowing attackers to bypass the deceptive file name warning in CPanel::IsVirus_Message. Attackers can craft archive entries like a PDF name followed by ideographic spaces and .hta to hide the real extension, executing script content via ShellExecuteExW when opened.

NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows authenticated base Viewers to obtain TLS client private keys by reading a base's data source. The source read handler masked only the connection password, letting attackers retrieve the decrypted private key, client certificate and CA to connect directly to the external database, bypassing NocoDB permissions.

A vulnerability has been found in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6. This vulnerability affects the function set_table of the file /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi. The vendor recommends: "1.5.1.6 isn't the latest version of 2960, the latest version fixes many security issues. And we have another one in our release plan which should solve the issues reported."

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in five Module Manager InstallerController actions that lack the admin/manage_modules ACL check and CSRF validation. Low-privilege users such as Front Office accounts can POST to saveConfig or SaveHooks to overwrite any module's configuration, retarget CCDA and HIE settings, and delete module hooks.

OpsTree REMS through 1.0.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access Governance API endpoints, including /api/v1/databases. Attackers can send requests without an Authorization header, or with invalid or tampered JWT tokens, to retrieve stored database hosts, usernames, and passwords.

NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server resources by sending unbounded filter arrays to shared-view bulk endpoints. Attackers with a shared view UUID can POST a large body of minimal filter objects, triggering a full database query per entry, to crash the NocoDB process.

NocoDB before 2026.08.1 contains a race condition vulnerability in users.service.ts that allows holders of a valid reset token to perform multiple password changes by sending concurrent reset requests. Attackers can exploit the window created by slow bcrypt hashing before the token is cleared to overwrite the owner's new password and lock them out.

C-Kermit 6.0.192 before 11.1.515 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in tn_snenv() in ckctel.c that allows malicious Telnet servers to corrupt client memory via crafted NEW-ENVIRON SEND subnegotiation. Malicious or machine-in-the-middle servers can send oversized variable names before authentication, overflowing a 16-byte stack buffer and a miscomputed heap buffer to corrupt stack and heap memory.

SurveyKing 1.13.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in result lookup: the anonymous survey view leaks the lookup configuration, including its password, and the lookup password check is skipped when no answer is sent. Unauthenticated attackers with a public survey link can inject a % wildcard into the MyBatis LIKE condition to match all responses, then call loadProject with an answerId to read complete responses including hidden fields.

Bolo (bolo-solo) 1.7 through 2.6.4 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read article view passwords via the public GET /articles endpoint. Attackers can retrieve the plaintext articleViewPwd field returned by ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage and submit it to read password-protected article content.

CloudPaste 1.1.0 through 1.9.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain WebDAV storage credentials through the unauthenticated /api/proxy/link endpoint. Attackers who know a public share slug can retrieve the Basic Authorization header containing the WebDAV username and password, then read, modify, or delete files on the WebDAV server.

B3log Solo through 4.4.0 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain article view passwords by querying the public GET /articles API. The ArticleProcessor.getArticlesByPage handler leaves the articleViewPwd property in JSON responses, letting attackers read passwords for encrypted articles and access their protected content.

V programming language standard library net.http through version 0.5.2 prior to commit 4077484 contains a TLS certificate validation bypass vulnerability that allows on-path attackers to intercept HTTPS traffic by exploiting the default false value of SSLConnectConfig.validate and FetchConfig.validate, which completes TLS handshakes without verifying certificates in both the mbedtls and OpenSSL backends. Attackers can present an expired, self-signed, wrong-hostname, or untrusted-root certificate to successfully complete the handshake via http.get, http.post, or http.fetch, enabling interception or modification of HTTPS traffic unless validate: true is explicitly configured.
Zoho Corporation ManageEngine ADAudit Plus versions below 8703 are vulnerable to an authenticated SQL injection vulnerability in ADAudit Plus Reports API.
Zoho Corporation ManageEngine ADAudit Plus versions below 8711 are vulnerable to an authenticated second order SQL injection vulnerability affecting ADAudit Plus custom reports module.

SOGo before 5.12.13 contains a missing rate limiting vulnerability in its web login TOTP verification that allows attackers who already possess a victim's password to brute-force the second-factor code without triggering any lockout. Attackers can send repeated POST requests to /SOGo/connect with wrong verification codes at high speed since failed TOTP attempts never increment the failed-login counter and SOGoMaximumFailedLoginCount does not apply, enabling indefinite guessing across 30-second code windows to bypass two-factor authentication.

NocoDB before 2026.08.0 contains a race condition in refresh-token rotation that allows attackers to reuse tokens because UserRefreshToken.ts never checks the affected-row count. Attackers holding a captured refresh token can present it concurrently with the legitimate user to obtain a valid authenticated session, and no reuse event is recorded.

Cudy TR3000 before 2.5.42 contains an argument injection vulnerability that allows a malicious or compromised ACS to inject curl options through unfiltered Username and Password values in the easycwmpd Upload handler. Attackers can embed whitespace to add options like -o and --url to the root-run curl command, writing attacker-controlled HTTP responses to arbitrary files on the device.

A local privilege escalation (LPE) vulnerability in the Audigy Rx driver’s Emupia2k.sys file could allow a local attacker with low privilege access to gain higher privileges, such as administrator rights.

A local privilege escalation (LPE) vulnerability in Pebble’s installers could allow a local attacker with low privilege access to place a malicious Dynamic Link Library (DLL) where a privileged executable file will load it.

WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated Videos Admin users to obtain video_id_hash values bound to any video owner via encoder endpoints like aVideoEncoderStatus.json.php. Attackers can request the hash for an administrator-owned video and replay it through useVideoHashOrLogin() for password-less login, gaining plugin upload, configuration, and user management access.
Dell PowerStore contains an Improper Authorization vulnerability. An authenticated user could exploit this vulnerability, potentially leading to privilege escalation to administrator.

Incorrect Privilege Assignment vulnerability in AtlasAiDev MCP Server for WordPress ai-workflow-automation-ai-agent-hub allows Privilege Escalation.This issue affects MCP Server for WordPress: from n/a through 2.0.3.
IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to obtain sensitive information due to server-side request forgery. Address checks can be bypassed, which could allow the server to reach destinations that should be blocked.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL commands due to SQL injection. Values received during sign-in are not properly neutralized before being used in a database query, which could allow SQL commands to run.

Firekylin through 2.18.1 contains an improper authorization vulnerability that allows editor-role users to read administrator-only secrets because the admin API base guard permits all GET actions. Editors can query options.js for TOTP secrets, push credentials, and cloud storage keys, or user.js for other users' app_key/app_secret to publish posts as administrators via admin/post_push.

Dolibarr 20.0.0 through 23.0.4 and 24.x before 24.0.2 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in api_expensereports.class.php payment endpoints that lets authenticated users access other users' expense report payments. Attackers with only expense report read and create rights can call getAllPayments, getPayments, addPayment, or updatePayment to read, create, or modify payments, falsifying reimbursement state.

Semantic MediaWiki 7.3.1 before 7.4.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in EditProtectionUpdater::userMayChangeProtection() that checks protection changes against the page's latest revision author. Editors can add {{#set:Is edit protected=false}} to a transcluded template, removing administrator edit and move protection logged under the administrator's name.

WWBN AVideo through 29.7.1 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in objects/import.json.php that allows uploaders to import other users' MP4 files by referencing any folder under videos/. Attackers can copy private, unlisted, password-protected or pay-per-view videos, read victims' .txt/.html sidecars as descriptions, list files via objects/listFiles.json.php, and delete victims' media using the delete parameter.

Improper neutralization of special elements used in an OS command in the remote SSH operation functionality of Lenovo XClarity Essentials OneCLI 5.5.0 for Linux could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with the privileges of the configured SSH account on a managed server by supplying a specially crafted remote path.

NocoDB before 2026.09.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read cross-base row comments by supplying only model and row ids. Attackers with a Viewer or Creator role on an unrelated base can read private comments and author emails, or plant decoy tables and duplicate comment ids to spoof teammates' comments.

OpenEMR before 8.5.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in diagnosis_full.php that allows authenticated users to delete or clear any billing record by ID. Attackers can supply a target billing ID in the id parameter with delete or clear mode to deactivate other patients' charges and corrupt financial records.

Zipline before 4.6.4 contains a resource allocation vulnerability that allows authenticated users to bypass chunked-upload size and quota checks by forging Content-Range offsets and totals. Attackers can send tiny chunks to the partial upload endpoint with large declared offsets, causing the server to create oversized files and exhaust disk space.

Frappe india-payroll before 16.0.4 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the get_employee_details, compute_tax_comparison and set_tax_regime methods of tax_regime_selector.py that allows authenticated low-privileged users to access other employees' payroll data. Attackers can supply another employee identifier to read base pay and earning and deduction components, or change the tax regime on draft Salary Structure Assignments to affect tax withholding.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Passionate Programmer Peter WP Data Access wp-data-access allows SQL Injection.This issue affects WP Data Access: from n/a through 5.5.92.

FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in flic_decode_frame_15_16BPP() in libavcodec/flicvideo.c that allows attackers to corrupt heap memory on big-endian builds. Attackers can supply a crafted 15/16 bpp FLIC/FLX file with an FLI_BRUN chunk whose non-terminating byte-swap loop writes packet-derived data past the frame buffer, crashing the process.

FFmpeg 7.0 before 8.1.3 and 9.x before 9.0.2 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in vk_av1_decode_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_av1.c because the tile-count limit is checked only on entry. Attackers can supply a crafted AV1 stream with more than 256 tiles decoded via the Vulkan hardware accelerator to overflow tile_sizes and corrupt heap memory.

FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in libavcodec/flicvideo.c that allows attackers to write out of bounds because check_pixel_ptr() checks only one bound with negative-stride frames. Attackers can supply a crafted FLIC file whose RLE and delta chunks write pixel data past frame storage, corrupting heap memory to crash applications or possibly execute code.

FFmpeg 7.1 through 9.0.2 contains an integer overflow in ff_vk_decode_add_slice() in libavcodec/vulkan_decode.c that miscalculates the Vulkan hwaccel bitstream buffer size. Attackers can supply a crafted stream with over 2 GiB of slice data per frame, causing memcpy() to write past a smaller pooled host-mapped buffer.

FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains an off-by-one heap overflow vulnerability in get_exponent_dynamic() in libavcodec/nellymoserenc.c that allows writing one element past the opt and path allocations. Attackers can supply crafted audio to applications encoding Nellymoser with trellis enabled, causing idx to equal OPT_SIZE and overwrite adjacent heap memory.

FFmpeg through 9.0.2 contains a double free vulnerability in libavcodec/cbs_sei.c where cbs_sei_delete_message() leaves a stale extension_data reference that ff_cbs_sei_add_message() reuses. Attackers can supply a crafted H.264 stream with a display orientation SEI message followed by payload extension data, processed by h264_metadata with display_orientation=insert, to corrupt heap memory.

Building a malicious package that uses "//go:cgo_import_dynamic" or links against a crafted PE object on Windows could pass unsafe library arguments to the external linker. The compiler only checked the first character of the library name in "//go:cgo_import_dynamic" directives and skipped validation in cgo-generated files. In addition, on Windows, "cmd/cgo" and "cmd/link" did not validate imported DLL names extracted from PE object files before emitting "-l<name>" flags for the external linker, allowing a crafted DLL name containing ".." path traversal or special characters to reference arbitrary files on disk. The compiler now validates every character of the library name in "//go:cgo_import_dynamic" directives (including in cgo-generated files on Windows) and rejects ".." path traversal, and "cmd/cgo" and "cmd/link" reject PE imported DLL names containing path separators, "..", ":", or leading "-" or "@".

Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) in Apache Roller 6.1.5 allows an authenticated user with entry-editing rights on a weblog to cause outbound HTTP requests to attacker-chosen destinations through legacy outbound Trackback and entry enclosure handling. The Trackback control is hidden in the standard UI, but its action remains directly reachable; the enclosure path is relevant only when an author supplies an enclosure URL. No non-default server configuration is required, and the default empty Trackback allow-list permits all destinations. Requests can reach loopback and private-network addresses, while enclosure handling exposes response status, content type, and length. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which removes the outbound trackback action and stops dereferencing enclosure URLs.

@fastify/multipart is the official Fastify plugin for handling multipart/form-data uploads. In versions 7.4.0 through 10.1.8, when the plugin is registered with the attachFieldsToBody option, the saveRequestFiles helper treats any object in the parsed request body that carries truthy file and buffer properties as an uploaded file. An unauthenticated client can forge such an object through a plain JSON request or a JSON-typed multipart field, so attacker-chosen bytes are written to the temporary directory while upload hooks and the file count and size limits are skipped, and the saved entry keeps the attacker's filename verbatim instead of being reduced to its basename. Because that filename can contain parent directory segments, applications that use it as a write destination, as the project README example does, are exposed to an arbitrary relative-path file write from a single request. The issue is fixed in @fastify/multipart 10.1.9, and users should upgrade to 10.1.9 or later. As a workaround, call saveRequestFiles only after confirming the request is multipart, and reduce each returned filename to its basename or validate it against an allowlist before using it as a destination.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

nvmet-tcp: check INIT_FAILED before nvmet_req_uninit in digest error path

In nvmet_tcp_try_recv_ddgst(), when a data digest mismatch is detected,
nvmet_req_uninit() is called unconditionally. However, if the command
arrived via the nvmet_tcp_handle_req_failure() path, nvmet_req_init()
had returned false and percpu_ref_tryget_live() was never executed. The
unconditional percpu_ref_put() inside nvmet_req_uninit() then causes a
refcount underflow, leading to a WARNING in
percpu_ref_switch_to_atomic_rcu, a use-after-free diagnostic, and
eventually a permanent workqueue deadlock.

Check cmd->flags & NVMET_TCP_F_INIT_FAILED before calling
nvmet_req_uninit(), matching the existing pattern in
nvmet_tcp_execute_request().

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

nvmet-tcp: Fix potential UAF when ddgst mismatch

Shivam Kumar found via vulnerability testing:
When data digest is enabled on an NVMe/TCP connection and a digest
mismatch occurs on a non-final H2C_DATA PDU during an R2T-based
data transfer, the digest error handler in nvmet_tcp_try_recv_ddgst()
calls nvmet_req_uninit() — which performs percpu_ref_put() on the
submission queue — but does NOT mark the command as completed. It
does not set cqe->status, does not modify rbytes_done, and does not
clear any flag. When the subsequent fatal error triggers queue
teardown, nvmet_tcp_uninit_data_in_cmds() iterates all commands,
checks nvmet_tcp_need_data_in() for each one, and finds that the
already-uninited command still appears to need data (because
rbytes_done < transfer_len and cqe->status == 0). It therefore calls
nvmet_req_uninit() a second time on the same command — a double
percpu_ref_put against a single percpu_ref_get.
IBM API Connect 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to gain full administrative control due to the use of hard-coded credentials.
IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.1.1 contains components that allow potentially unsafe command execution, which could be exploited to run arbitrary system commands on the host.

The security constraint generated for EJB JAX-WS endpoints with configured authentication protects only some HTTP methods. A remote unauthenticated attacker can bypass authentication by sending requests with another HTTP method. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The internal system EJBs used for remote deployment and configuration did not enforce their administrative role check when the server ran with the default profile. A remote unauthenticated attacker able to reach the remote EJB endpoint could deploy arbitrary applications and execute code. Only installations that enabled the system applications and a remote EJB endpoint are exposed. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The JDBC based JAAS login module accepts a login without a password for accounts whose stored password is NULL. A remote attacker who knows the user name of such an account can authenticate as that user and obtain its roles. Only deployments using this login module with NULL passwords in the user table are affected. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

When MicroProfile JWT role-based access control is used, the access constraints of JAX-RS resources are not always enforced as declared: resources that declare an empty set of allowed roles are accessible to every caller, resource classes that inherit the same method from a common superclass share their constraints, and class-level constraints declared on a superclass are ignored. A remote attacker can invoke resources that should be denied to them, in some configurations without authentication. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

After a successful WS-Security UsernameToken authentication, the caller identity stays associated with the worker thread once the request completes when web services are served by the standalone OpenEJB HTTP server. A remote unauthenticated attacker whose request is later processed on the same thread can invoke protected EJB methods with the identity of a previously authenticated user. Users are recommended to upgrade to version 10.3.0 or 11.0.0-M2, which fix the issue.

The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server reports every request as authenticated when an application requests authentication programmatically. A remote unauthenticated attacker can access functionality protected this way. Only applications served by the embedded HTTP server that rely on programmatic authentication are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

When JAX-WS or JAX-RS endpoints are published by the embedded OpenEJB HTTP server rather than Tomcat, some configured authentication methods are silently ignored and the endpoint is published without authentication. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke the exposed operations without credentials. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server and rely on such an authentication method are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

The embedded OpenEJB HTTP server dispatches some requests to REST endpoints configured for HTTP Basic authentication without verifying credentials. A remote unauthenticated attacker can invoke protected resources, bypassing authentication. Only deployments that use the embedded HTTP server with Basic authentication are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

The embedded HTTP server does not clear the security identity established during a request before its worker thread handles the next request. A remote unauthenticated attacker can have their request processed with the identity of a previously authenticated user, gaining that user's privileges. Only applications served by the embedded HTTP server that authenticate programmatically or via basic authentication are affected. Users are recommended to block network access to the embedded HTTP server from untrusted clients, or to migrate to the Tomcat based TomEE distributions.

rabbitmq-c is a C-language AMQP client library for RabbitMQ. Prior to version 0.17.0, a heap buffer overflow exists in rabbitmq-c when the public amqp_send_frame() API is used to serialize an oversized AMQP_FRAME_BODY. The issue occurs because amqp_frame_to_bytes() copies frame.payload.body_fragment.len bytes into the connection outbound buffer without validating that the body fragment fits within the allocated frame buffer. An application that passes an oversized body frame to amqp_send_frame() can trigger a heap out-of-bounds write, resulting in process crash and memory corruption. This issue has been patched in version 0.17.0.

Building a package containing a crafted ".syso" file could bypass cgo flag validation and inject arbitrary linker flags when linking. When loading ".syso" entries from a package archive, the linker only checked for recognized host object headers (ELF, Mach-O, PE, and XCOFF) before falling through to Go object parsing. A ".syso" file beginning with a "go object" header was parsed as a Go compiler object, allowing untrusted cgo metadata directives (such as "cgo_ldflag" or "cgo_dynamic_linker") embedded in the ".syso" file to be passed to the external linker without validation. Additionally, ".syso" filenames longer than 16 bytes lost their ".syso" extension when truncated in archive headers, and unrecognized ".syso" formats forced external linking in pure-Go builds. The linker now rejects ".syso" files that are not recognized host object formats, and "cmd/go" and "cmd/pack" preserve the ".syso" suffix when truncating long archive member names.

Data::Dump::Streamer versions before 3.00 for Perl allow code injection via unescaped Regexp patterns in _dump_qr.

A Regexp's pattern is written into a qr literal without escaping "$" or "@", so "@{[ ... ]}" and "${\ ... }" in the pattern run as code when the dump is evaluated. An already escaped delimiter gets a second backslash, which leaves the delimiter bare and ends the qr literal early.

An attacker who supplies a pattern that an application compiles, dumps and later restores with eval or do can run arbitrary Perl code.

The Auth Armor  WordPress plugin through 1.0.3 does not require authentication on several handlers available to logged-out users, which leak the site's stored API credentials and allow an unauthenticated attacker to reset an administrator's enrollment and take over that administrator account.

The Custom Block Builder  WordPress plugin before 3.0.0 does not properly deny unauthorised requests to its REST routes, as its permission checks return a non-error response that WordPress treats as granted, allowing unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary PHP code on the server.

Sandbox escape in the DOM: Navigation component. This vulnerability was fixed in Firefox 160, Firefox ESR 153.7, Thunderbird 160, and Thunderbird 153.7.

IBM API Connect 10.0.8.0 through 10.0.8.12 and 12.1.0.0 through 12.1.1.2 could allow a remote attacker to execute unauthorized administrative operations and obtain sensitive information due to improper handling of case sensitivity. Access controls are not applied consistently to all variations of a request, which could allow restricted operations to be reached.
